topics.name: WHO Classification & Molecular Markers
topics.blurb: WHO 2021 integrated diagnosis principles, grading, and the molecular alterations that define CNS tumors.

topics.name: Diffuse Gliomas
topics.blurb: Adult diffuse gliomas from low-grade glioma to glioblastoma: biology, surgery, and oncologic management.

topics.name: Meningioma
topics.blurb: Meningioma grading, common locations, observation, radiosurgery, and resection of atypical/anaplastic disease.

topics.name: Brain Metastases
topics.blurb: Single and multiple intracranial metastases: imaging, SRS versus WBRT, resection, and leptomeningeal disease.

topics.name: Sellar & Parasellar Region
topics.blurb: Pituitary adenomas, functional syndromes, apoplexy, craniopharyngioma, Rathke cyst, and postoperative endocrine care.

topics.name: Primary CNS Lymphoma
topics.blurb: Diagnosis, steroid pitfalls, biopsy strategy, and chemotherapy-based management of primary CNS lymphoma.

topics.name: Intraventricular Tumors
topics.blurb: Colloid cyst, central neurocytoma, subependymoma, choroid plexus tumors, and intracranial ependymoma.

topics.name: Pineal Region Tumors
topics.blurb: Germ cell and pineal parenchymal tumors, tumor markers, Parinaud syndrome, and hydrocephalus management.

topics.name: Hemangioblastoma & Other Rare Tumors
topics.blurb: Hemangioblastoma/VHL, epidermoid and dermoid cysts, and uncommon glioneuronal and mesenchymal tumors.

topics.name: Intramedullary Spinal Cord Tumors
topics.blurb: Intradural-intramedullary cord tumors: ependymoma, astrocytoma, and hemangioblastoma evaluation and resection.

topics.name: Tumor Syndromes & Neuro-Oncologic Phenomena
topics.blurb: Neurocutaneous tumor predisposition syndromes, paraneoplastic disorders, and tumor-associated epilepsy.

topics.name: Surgical Adjuncts & Oncologic Therapeutics
topics.blurb: Edema control, intraoperative adjuncts, radiation principles, chemotherapy, LITT, and multidisciplinary integration.

concepts.name: WHO 2021 CNS tumor classification principles
concepts.blurb: Mastery means knowing the 2021 WHO scheme integrates histology and molecular features into a single diagnosis.

concepts.name: Integrated histomolecular diagnosis
concepts.blurb: Layered diagnosis combining histologic type, CNS WHO grade, and defining molecular markers into one integrated report.

concepts.name: CNS WHO grading (1-4)
concepts.blurb: Arabic-numeral grades 1-4 reflecting biologic aggressiveness, now assigned within tumor type rather than across types.

concepts.name: IDH1/IDH2 mutation
concepts.blurb: IDH mutation defines lower-grade adult gliomas and astrocytomas, conferring better prognosis than IDH-wildtype.
acgme: Tumor Genetics - IDH Mutation TERT EGFR Amplification MGMT Methylation

concepts.name: 1p/19q codeletion
concepts.blurb: Whole-arm 1p/19q codeletion plus IDH mutation defines oligodendroglioma and predicts chemo/radiation sensitivity.
acgme: Neuropathology of Brain Tumors - WHO Classification Molecular Markers (IDH EGFR 1p or 19q)

concepts.name: ATRX loss and astrocytic lineage
concepts.blurb: ATRX loss (with TP53 mutation) marks astrocytoma lineage and is mutually exclusive with 1p/19q codeletion.
acgme: Neuropathology of Brain Tumors - WHO Classification Molecular Markers (IDH EGFR 1p or 19q)

concepts.name: MGMT promoter methylation
concepts.blurb: MGMT promoter methylation silences DNA repair, predicting temozolomide benefit and improved survival in glioblastoma.
acgme: Tumor Genetics - IDH Mutation TERT EGFR Amplification MGMT Methylation

concepts.name: TERT promoter mutation
concepts.blurb: TERT promoter mutation supports oligodendroglioma (with codeletion) or, in IDH-wildtype, aggressive glioblastoma biology.
acgme: Tumor Genetics - IDH Mutation TERT EGFR Amplification MGMT Methylation

concepts.name: EGFR amplification
concepts.blurb: EGFR amplification is a glioblastoma hallmark; with EGFRvIII it drives proliferation and molecular grade-4 designation.
acgme: Tumor Genetics - IDH Mutation TERT EGFR Amplification MGMT Methylation

concepts.name: Molecular upgrading to glioblastoma
concepts.blurb: IDH-wildtype astrocytoma with EGFR amplification, TERT mutation, or +7/-10 is graded glioblastoma despite low-grade histology.

concepts.name: H3 K27M-altered diffuse midline glioma
concepts.blurb: H3 K27M alteration defines an aggressive WHO grade 4 diffuse midline glioma regardless of bland histology.
acgme: Neuropathology of Brain Tumors - WHO Classification Molecular Markers (IDH EGFR 1p or 19q)

concepts.name: BRAF V600E and fusion alterations
concepts.blurb: BRAF V600E or KIAA1549 fusion marks pilocytic, ganglioglioma, PXA, and targets BRAF/MEK inhibitor therapy.
acgme: Neuropathology of Brain Tumors - WHO Classification Molecular Markers (IDH EGFR 1p or 19q)

concepts.name: CDKN2A/B homozygous deletion
concepts.blurb: CDKN2A/B homozygous deletion upgrades IDH-mutant astrocytoma to CNS WHO grade 4 and worsens prognosis.
acgme: Tumor Genetics - IDH Mutation TERT EGFR Amplification MGMT Methylation

concepts.name: Ki-67/MIB-1 proliferation index
concepts.blurb: Immunohistochemical proliferation index gauging mitotic activity; high values suggest higher-grade, more aggressive tumors.
acgme: Neuropathology of Brain Tumors - WHO Classification Molecular Markers (IDH EGFR 1p or 19q)

concepts.name: Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype
concepts.blurb: Most common malignant primary brain tumor; IDH-wildtype WHO grade 4 with necrosis and microvascular proliferation.

concepts.name: Glioblastoma imaging features
concepts.blurb: Irregular ring-enhancing mass with central necrosis, thick rim, surrounding non-enhancing infiltration, and mass effect.
acgme: Brain MRI Sequences - T1 T2 FLAIR DWI SWI T1Gad - Clinical Application

concepts.name: High-grade glioma presentation
concepts.blurb: Subacute headache, focal deficit, seizure, or cognitive change from a rapidly growing infiltrative hemispheric mass.
acgme: ICP Elevation in Brain Tumors - Recognition and Management

concepts.name: Stupp protocol (concurrent chemoradiation)
concepts.blurb: Maximal safe resection then 60 Gy radiation with concurrent and adjuvant temozolomide—the glioblastoma standard of care.
acgme: Neuro-Oncology - Radiation and Chemotherapy Principles (Temozolomide MGMT IDH)

concepts.name: Tumor-treating fields
concepts.blurb: Alternating electric-field scalp arrays added to maintenance temozolomide that prolong glioblastoma survival (EF-14 trial).
acgme: Neuro-Oncology - Radiation and Chemotherapy Principles (Temozolomide MGMT IDH)

concepts.name: Astrocytoma, IDH-mutant
concepts.blurb: IDH-mutant, 1p/19q-intact diffuse astrocytoma (grade 2-4) with ATRX loss and better prognosis than glioblastoma.

concepts.name: Oligodendroglioma, IDH-mutant 1p/19q-codeleted
concepts.blurb: IDH-mutant, 1p/19q-codeleted glioma with fried-egg cells and calcification; chemo/radiation-responsive, relatively indolent.

concepts.name: Adult low-grade (grade 2) diffuse glioma
concepts.blurb: IDH-mutant grade 2 diffuse glioma, often seizure-presenting, with slow growth and risk of malignant transformation.

concepts.name: Low-grade glioma surgical timing
concepts.blurb: Early maximal safe resection over watchful waiting improves survival; high-risk LGG receives radiation plus PCV chemotherapy.

concepts.name: Extent of resection and survival
concepts.blurb: Greater extent of resection (and minimal residual contrast volume) independently improves survival across glioma grades.
acgme: Extent of Resection - GTR vs STR vs Biopsy - Outcomes Evidence

concepts.name: Supratotal resection of glioma
concepts.blurb: Resection beyond contrast-enhancing margins into FLAIR-abnormal tissue in non-eloquent regions to further extend survival.
acgme: Extent of Resection - GTR vs STR vs Biopsy - Outcomes Evidence

concepts.name: Awake craniotomy for eloquent glioma
concepts.blurb: Awake mapping indicated for tumors in or near language, motor, or other eloquent cortex to maximize safe resection.

concepts.name: Intraoperative cortical/subcortical mapping
concepts.blurb: Direct electrical stimulation maps language, motor, and white-matter tracts to define resectable boundaries.
acgme: Intraoperative Cortical Mapping (Motor Language) for Epilepsy or Tumor

concepts.name: Stereotactic brain biopsy
concepts.blurb: Frame-based or frameless needle biopsy for diagnosis of deep, multifocal, or unresectable lesions.

concepts.name: Carmustine (Gliadel) wafers
concepts.blurb: Biodegradable BCNU-impregnated wafers placed in the resection cavity for local chemotherapy; modest survival benefit.
acgme: Neuro-Oncology - Radiation and Chemotherapy Principles (Temozolomide MGMT IDH)

concepts.name: Bevacizumab in recurrent glioma
concepts.blurb: Anti-VEGF antibody improving edema and progression-free survival in recurrent glioblastoma without proven overall-survival gain.
acgme: Neuro-Oncology - Radiation and Chemotherapy Principles (Temozolomide MGMT IDH)

concepts.name: Pseudoprogression vs true progression
concepts.blurb: Treatment-related enhancement within months of chemoradiation mimicking tumor growth; perfusion and follow-up distinguish it.
acgme: Advanced MRI - Spectroscopy Perfusion Functional MRI in Neurosurgery

concepts.name: Recurrent glioma management
concepts.blurb: Recurrence options include re-resection, re-irradiation, systemic agents, or trials, individualized by performance status and location.
acgme: Neuro-Oncology - Radiation and Chemotherapy Principles (Temozolomide MGMT IDH)

concepts.name: Diffuse midline glioma, H3 K27-altered
concepts.blurb: Infiltrative thalamic, brainstem, or spinal cord glioma with H3 K27 alteration; uniformly poor prognosis.
acgme: Brainstem Glioma or DIPG and Biopsy

concepts.name: Elderly/frail glioblastoma regimens
concepts.blurb: Hypofractionated radiation with or without temozolomide for older patients, guided by MGMT status and performance status.
acgme: Neuro-Oncology - Radiation and Chemotherapy Principles (Temozolomide MGMT IDH)

concepts.name: Meningioma pathology and origin
concepts.blurb: Extra-axial dural-based tumor arising from arachnoid cap cells with whorls and psammoma bodies.

concepts.name: Meningioma WHO grading
concepts.blurb: Grade 1 benign, grade 2 atypical (brain invasion or ≥4 mitoses), grade 3 anaplastic by histology/molecular criteria.

concepts.name: Meningioma imaging features
concepts.blurb: Homogeneously enhancing extra-axial mass with dural tail, CSF cleft, and possible hyperostosis or calcification.
acgme: Brain MRI Sequences - T1 T2 FLAIR DWI SWI T1Gad - Clinical Application

concepts.name: Simpson resection grade
concepts.blurb: Grades I-V scoring completeness of resection including dura and bone; predicts symptomatic recurrence risk.

concepts.name: Convexity meningioma resection
concepts.blurb: Resection of a convexity meningioma with a surrounding dural margin, the prototypical Simpson grade I scenario.

concepts.name: Parasagittal and falcine meningioma
concepts.blurb: Meningioma involving the superior sagittal sinus or falx; resection weighs sinus patency against recurrence.

concepts.name: Observation of incidental meningioma
concepts.blurb: Small asymptomatic meningiomas without edema can be observed with serial imaging rather than treated immediately.

concepts.name: Radiosurgery for meningioma
concepts.blurb: Stereotactic radiosurgery controls small or residual meningiomas and surgically high-risk locations with high tumor-control rates.
acgme: Stereotactic Radiosurgery for Brain Tumors (Gamma Knife CyberKnife)

concepts.name: Atypical (grade 2) meningioma management
concepts.blurb: Gross total resection with consideration of adjuvant radiation given the higher recurrence rate of grade 2 disease.

concepts.name: Anaplastic (grade 3) meningioma management
concepts.blurb: Aggressive malignant meningioma requiring maximal resection plus adjuvant radiation; high recurrence and mortality.

concepts.name: Preoperative meningioma embolization
concepts.blurb: Endovascular devascularization of dural feeders to reduce intraoperative blood loss in large vascular meningiomas.

concepts.name: Meningioma peritumoral edema
concepts.blurb: Vasogenic edema, common in secretory and high-grade meningiomas, contributing to symptoms and surgical risk.
acgme: Peritumoral Edema - Dexamethasone and Medical Management

concepts.name: Meningioma recurrence and surveillance
concepts.blurb: Recurrence risk rises with higher grade and incomplete Simpson resection, driving long-term imaging surveillance.

concepts.name: Meningioma molecular drivers
concepts.blurb: NF2 loss is most common; non-NF2 drivers (AKT1, SMO, TRAF7, KLF4) correlate with location and behavior.
acgme: Neuropathology of Brain Tumors - WHO Classification Molecular Markers (IDH EGFR 1p or 19q)

concepts.name: Brain metastasis epidemiology and primaries
concepts.blurb: Most common intracranial tumor in adults; lung, breast, melanoma, renal, and colorectal are leading primaries.

concepts.name: Brain metastasis imaging
concepts.blurb: Multiple well-circumscribed gray-white junction lesions with disproportionate vasogenic edema and ring or nodular enhancement.

concepts.name: Single brain metastasis management
concepts.blurb: Accessible single metastasis with controlled systemic disease favors resection or SRS plus systemic therapy.

concepts.name: Multiple brain metastases management
concepts.blurb: Multiple metastases are increasingly treated with SRS to several lesions, reserving WBRT for diffuse disease.

concepts.name: SRS versus whole-brain radiotherapy
concepts.blurb: SRS spares neurocognition versus WBRT for limited metastases; WBRT reserved for extensive or leptomeningeal disease.
acgme: Stereotactic Radiosurgery for Brain Tumors (Gamma Knife CyberKnife)

concepts.name: Indications for metastasis resection
concepts.blurb: Resection favored for large symptomatic lesions causing mass effect, uncertain diagnosis, or posterior fossa compression.

concepts.name: Postoperative cavity radiosurgery
concepts.blurb: SRS to the resection cavity improves local control over observation while avoiding WBRT-related cognitive decline.
acgme: Stereotactic Radiosurgery for Brain Tumors (Gamma Knife CyberKnife)

concepts.name: Leptomeningeal carcinomatosis
concepts.blurb: Diffuse meningeal tumor seeding causing cranial neuropathies and hydrocephalus; diagnosed by CSF cytology and enhancement.

concepts.name: Hemorrhagic metastases
concepts.blurb: Melanoma, renal cell, choriocarcinoma, and thyroid metastases bleed readily, complicating diagnosis and surgical planning.

concepts.name: Graded Prognostic Assessment
concepts.blurb: Diagnosis-specific GPA estimates survival from age, performance status, extracranial disease, and lesion number to guide therapy.

concepts.name: Pituitary adenoma overview
concepts.blurb: Benign anterior pituitary tumors classified by hormone secretion and size; now termed pituitary neuroendocrine tumors.

concepts.name: Microadenoma versus macroadenoma
concepts.blurb: Adenomas under 10 mm are microadenomas; ≥10 mm macroadenomas threaten the chiasm and cavernous sinus.

concepts.name: Pituitary/sellar imaging
concepts.blurb: Dedicated pituitary MRI with dynamic contrast shows adenoma, chiasm displacement, and cavernous sinus (Knosp) invasion.
acgme: Sellar and Parasellar Anatomy - Pituitary Cavernous Sinus Optic Chiasm

concepts.name: Bitemporal hemianopia from sellar mass
concepts.blurb: Suprasellar extension compresses the optic chiasm, producing bitemporal hemianopia and a key surgical indication.
acgme: Neuro-Ophthalmology - Visual Field Defects Pupillary Reflexes Diplopia Localization

concepts.name: Prolactinoma
concepts.blurb: Most common functioning adenoma, causing galactorrhea, amenorrhea, or hypogonadism with markedly elevated prolactin.

concepts.name: Dopamine agonist therapy for prolactinoma
concepts.blurb: Cabergoline or bromocriptine is first-line and shrinks most prolactinomas, making surgery a second-line option.

concepts.name: Acromegaly (GH-secreting adenoma)
concepts.blurb: Growth-hormone excess causing acral enlargement, organomegaly, and metabolic disease; confirmed by elevated IGF-1 and OGTT.

concepts.name: Acromegaly adjuvant medical therapy
concepts.blurb: Somatostatin analogs, pegvisomant, or dopamine agonists control residual GH excess when surgery is not curative.

concepts.name: Cushing disease (ACTH adenoma)
concepts.blurb: ACTH-secreting corticotroph adenoma causing hypercortisolism; often a small, hard-to-localize microadenoma.

concepts.name: Hypercortisolism biochemical workup
concepts.blurb: Late-night salivary cortisol, 24-hour urine free cortisol, and dexamethasone suppression confirm and localize hypercortisolism.

concepts.name: Inferior petrosal sinus sampling
concepts.blurb: Bilateral venous sampling distinguishing pituitary (Cushing disease) from ectopic ACTH when imaging is equivocal.

concepts.name: Nonfunctioning pituitary adenoma
concepts.blurb: Clinically silent (often gonadotroph) adenoma presenting with mass effect, visual loss, or hypopituitarism rather than hormone excess.

concepts.name: TSH-secreting adenoma
concepts.blurb: Rare thyrotroph adenoma causing central hyperthyroidism with inappropriately normal or elevated TSH.

concepts.name: Pituitary apoplexy
concepts.blurb: Sudden adenoma hemorrhage/infarction causing thunderclap headache, ophthalmoplegia, visual loss, and adrenal crisis.

concepts.name: Endoscopic transsphenoidal resection
concepts.blurb: Endonasal transsphenoidal approach is standard for most adenomas, decompressing the chiasm and preserving pituitary function.
acgme: Endoscopic Transsphenoidal Surgery for Pituitary Tumors

concepts.name: Postoperative CSF leak and skull base repair
concepts.blurb: Intraoperative leaks are closed with grafts and nasoseptal flap; postoperative rhinorrhea risks meningitis.
acgme: Endoscopic Transsphenoidal Surgery for Pituitary Tumors

concepts.name: Hypopituitarism evaluation
concepts.blurb: Baseline anterior pituitary panel assesses adrenal, thyroid, gonadal, GH, and prolactin axes before and after surgery.

concepts.name: Postoperative diabetes insipidus
concepts.blurb: ADH deficiency after sellar surgery causing dilute polyuria, hypernatremia, and rising serum osmolality; treated with desmopressin.
acgme: Diabetes Insipidus - Post-Pituitary or Skull Base Surgery and TBI

concepts.name: Postoperative SIADH and triphasic response
concepts.blurb: Delayed hyponatremia from inappropriate ADH release, often the middle phase of the triphasic pattern after pituitary surgery.
acgme: Sodium Disorders in Neurocritical Care - SIADH vs CSW - Diagnosis and Treatment

concepts.name: Craniopharyngioma
concepts.blurb: Sellar/suprasellar epithelial tumor; adult papillary (BRAF) and adamantinomatous types with calcification and cystic machinery-oil fluid.

concepts.name: Craniopharyngioma management
concepts.blurb: Balance aggressive resection against hypothalamic injury; subtotal resection plus radiation often preferred, with BRAF therapy emerging.

concepts.name: Rathke cleft cyst
concepts.blurb: Benign sellar/suprasellar cyst from Rathke pouch remnants; often incidental, drained when symptomatic.

concepts.name: Primary CNS lymphoma pathology
concepts.blurb: Aggressive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma confined to CNS, angiocentric, more common in immunocompromised patients.

concepts.name: CNS lymphoma imaging
concepts.blurb: Homogeneously enhancing periventricular mass with restricted diffusion that crosses the corpus callosum; less necrosis than GBM.

concepts.name: Steroid-induced lesion regression (ghost tumor)
concepts.blurb: Corticosteroids transiently shrink lymphoma and obscure histology, so steroids are held until biopsy when possible.

concepts.name: Lymphoma diagnosis by biopsy
concepts.blurb: Stereotactic biopsy, not resection, establishes diagnosis since lymphoma is chemo/radiosensitive rather than surgical.

concepts.name: High-dose methotrexate regimens
concepts.blurb: High-dose methotrexate-based chemotherapy is the backbone of CNS lymphoma treatment, with surgery limited to diagnosis.

concepts.name: CSF and ophthalmologic staging
concepts.blurb: CSF cytology/flow cytometry and slit-lamp exam stage lymphoma for leptomeningeal and vitreoretinal involvement.

concepts.name: Colloid cyst of the third ventricle
concepts.blurb: Benign cyst at the foramen of Monro that can cause acute obstructive hydrocephalus and sudden death.
acgme: Colloid Cyst of the Third Ventricle

concepts.name: Colloid cyst management
concepts.blurb: Symptomatic or large cysts with hydrocephalus are resected (endoscopic or transcallosal); small incidental cysts can be observed.
acgme: Colloid Cyst of the Third Ventricle

concepts.name: Central neurocytoma
concepts.blurb: Young-adult intraventricular tumor near the septum pellucidum, synaptophysin-positive, generally benign with good resection outcomes.

concepts.name: Subependymoma
concepts.blurb: Slow-growing benign WHO grade 1 tumor, typically incidental in the fourth or lateral ventricle of older adults.

concepts.name: Intracranial ependymoma
concepts.blurb: Ependymal tumor arising in the ventricles or fourth ventricle; molecular groups guide grade and adjuvant therapy.

concepts.name: Choroid plexus papilloma
concepts.blurb: Benign CSF-overproducing papillary tumor causing hydrocephalus; gross total resection is usually curative.

concepts.name: Choroid plexus carcinoma
concepts.blurb: Malignant pediatric-predominant choroid plexus tumor with CSF dissemination, linked to TP53/Li-Fraumeni; needs adjuvant therapy.

concepts.name: Intraventricular meningioma
concepts.blurb: Meningioma arising from choroid plexus stroma, usually in the atrium of the lateral ventricle.

concepts.name: Tumor-related obstructive hydrocephalus
concepts.blurb: Intraventricular tumors obstruct CSF pathways; treat with EVD, ETV, or tumor removal to relieve hydrocephalus.
acgme: ICP Elevation in Brain Tumors - Recognition and Management

concepts.name: Pineal region tumor differential
concepts.blurb: Pineal masses include germ cell tumors, pineal parenchymal tumors, gliomas, and tectal/cystic lesions.

concepts.name: Pineal germinoma
concepts.blurb: Most common pineal germ cell tumor, highly radiosensitive; biopsy/markers establish diagnosis before chemoradiation.

concepts.name: Germ cell tumor markers (AFP, β-hCG)
concepts.blurb: Serum/CSF AFP and β-hCG separate pure germinoma from secreting nongerminomatous germ cell tumors and guide management.

concepts.name: Pineal parenchymal tumors
concepts.blurb: Spectrum from benign pineocytoma to malignant pineoblastoma; the latter is a CSF-seeding embryonal tumor.

concepts.name: Parinaud (dorsal midbrain) syndrome
concepts.blurb: Upgaze palsy, light-near dissociation, and convergence-retraction nystagmus from tectal compression by a pineal mass.
acgme: Cranial Nerves I-XII - Anatomy Nuclei and Clinical Syndromes

concepts.name: Pineal-region hydrocephalus and ETV
concepts.blurb: Aqueductal compression causes obstructive hydrocephalus, often managed by endoscopic third ventriculostomy plus biopsy.
acgme: Pediatric Pineal Region Tumors - ETV and Resection

concepts.name: Pineal region surgical approaches
concepts.blurb: Supracerebellar-infratentorial and occipital-transtentorial corridors access pineal tumors needing resection beyond biopsy.

concepts.name: Hemangioblastoma
concepts.blurb: Benign vascular tumor, most common posterior fossa primary in adults, sometimes secreting erythropoietin causing polycythemia.

concepts.name: Hemangioblastoma imaging and angioarchitecture
concepts.blurb: Classic cyst with an avidly enhancing mural nodule and flow voids; angiography aids preoperative embolization planning.

concepts.name: Von Hippel-Lindau disease
concepts.blurb: VHL gene tumor-suppressor syndrome causing CNS/retinal hemangioblastomas, renal cell carcinoma, and pheochromocytoma.

concepts.name: Intracranial epidermoid cyst
concepts.blurb: Congenital ectodermal inclusion cyst with keratin debris that insinuates around cisterns and encases neurovascular structures.

concepts.name: Epidermoid diffusion imaging
concepts.blurb: Epidermoids restrict on DWI and follow CSF on other sequences, distinguishing them from non-restricting arachnoid cysts.

concepts.name: Intracranial dermoid cyst
concepts.blurb: Midline cyst with dermal elements and fat; rupture causes chemical meningitis from disseminated fat droplets.

concepts.name: Solitary fibrous tumor (hemangiopericytoma)
concepts.blurb: Aggressive dural-based mesenchymal tumor (STAT6-positive) mimicking meningioma but prone to recurrence and metastasis.

concepts.name: Dysembryoplastic neuroepithelial tumor
concepts.blurb: Benign cortical glioneuronal tumor causing drug-resistant seizures in young patients; resection is often curative.

concepts.name: Ganglioglioma
concepts.blurb: Low-grade glioneuronal tumor (often BRAF V600E) in the temporal lobe presenting with chronic epilepsy.

concepts.name: Pleomorphic xanthoastrocytoma
concepts.blurb: Superficial temporal glioma in young patients, BRAF V600E-associated, with eosinophilic granular bodies and relatively good prognosis.

concepts.name: Intramedullary spinal cord tumor overview
concepts.blurb: Intra-axial cord tumors—mostly ependymoma, astrocytoma, hemangioblastoma—presenting with myelopathy and a central cord syndrome.
acgme: Intramedullary Spinal Cord Tumors (Ependymoma Astrocytoma Hemangioblastoma)

concepts.name: Intramedullary tumor presentation
concepts.blurb: Insidious myelopathy with dissociated sensory loss, pain, and progressive weakness; syrinx may extend symptoms.
acgme: Spine Neurological Examination - Localizing Radiculopathy and Myelopathy

concepts.name: Intramedullary tumor MRI
concepts.blurb: Cord expansion with enhancement, associated cysts/syrinx, and a cap sign favoring ependymoma helps differentiate tumor types.
acgme: Spine MRI and CT Interpretation - Disc Stenosis Fracture Tumor

concepts.name: Spinal cord ependymoma
concepts.blurb: Most common adult intramedullary tumor; well-circumscribed with a cleavage plane allowing gross total resection.
acgme: Intramedullary Spinal Cord Tumors (Ependymoma Astrocytoma Hemangioblastoma)

concepts.name: Spinal cord astrocytoma
concepts.blurb: Infiltrative cord glioma without a clear plane, limiting resection; prognosis depends on grade.
acgme: Intramedullary Spinal Cord Tumors (Ependymoma Astrocytoma Hemangioblastoma)

concepts.name: Spinal cord hemangioblastoma
concepts.blurb: Vascular intramedullary tumor, frequently VHL-associated and multiple, often with an associated syrinx.
acgme: Intramedullary Spinal Cord Tumors (Ependymoma Astrocytoma Hemangioblastoma)

concepts.name: Myxopapillary ependymoma
concepts.blurb: Distinct ependymoma of the conus/filum terminale; en bloc resection minimizes recurrence and CSF seeding.
acgme: Intramedullary Spinal Cord Tumors (Ependymoma Astrocytoma Hemangioblastoma)

concepts.name: Intramedullary tumor resection technique
concepts.blurb: Midline myelotomy with neuromonitoring; resectability depends on a dissection plane, favorable in ependymoma over astrocytoma.
acgme: Intramedullary Spinal Cord Tumors (Ependymoma Astrocytoma Hemangioblastoma)

concepts.name: Neurofibromatosis type 1
concepts.blurb: NF1 (neurofibromin) syndrome with café-au-lait spots, neurofibromas, optic pathway glioma, and MPNST risk.
acgme: Neuropathology of Developmental and Genetic Disorders (Tuberous Sclerosis NF1 or NF2)

concepts.name: Neurofibromatosis type 2
concepts.blurb: NF2 (merlin) syndrome defined by bilateral vestibular schwannomas, multiple meningiomas, and ependymomas.
acgme: Neuropathology of Developmental and Genetic Disorders (Tuberous Sclerosis NF1 or NF2)

concepts.name: Tuberous sclerosis complex
concepts.blurb: TSC1/TSC2 syndrome with cortical tubers, subependymal nodules, and SEGA causing obstructive hydrocephalus; mTOR inhibitors help.
acgme: Neuropathology of Developmental and Genetic Disorders (Tuberous Sclerosis NF1 or NF2)

concepts.name: Li-Fraumeni syndrome
concepts.blurb: Germline TP53 mutation predisposing to gliomas, choroid plexus carcinoma, medulloblastoma, and many systemic cancers.
acgme: Neuropathology of Developmental and Genetic Disorders (Tuberous Sclerosis NF1 or NF2)

concepts.name: Turcot syndrome
concepts.blurb: Hereditary association of colorectal polyposis or Lynch syndrome with gliomas and medulloblastoma.
acgme: Neuropathology of Developmental and Genetic Disorders (Tuberous Sclerosis NF1 or NF2)

concepts.name: Paraneoplastic neurologic syndromes
concepts.blurb: Autoantibody-mediated remote effects of systemic cancer (limbic encephalitis, cerebellar degeneration) prompting tumor search.
acgme: Neuropathology of Brain Tumors - WHO Classification Molecular Markers (IDH EGFR 1p or 19q)

concepts.name: Tumor-associated epilepsy
concepts.blurb: Seizures common with cortical and low-grade tumors; levetiracetam preferred, with extent of resection improving control.
acgme: Tumor-Related Epilepsy - AED Selection and Perioperative Management

concepts.name: Peritumoral vasogenic edema
concepts.blurb: Tumor-induced BBB breakdown causes vasogenic edema, mass effect, and neurologic symptoms responsive to steroids.
acgme: Peritumoral Edema - Dexamethasone and Medical Management

concepts.name: Dexamethasone for tumor edema
concepts.blurb: Dexamethasone stabilizes the BBB and rapidly reduces peritumoral edema and symptoms; held before lymphoma biopsy.
acgme: Peritumoral Edema - Dexamethasone and Medical Management

concepts.name: Frameless neuronavigation
concepts.blurb: Image-guided stereotaxy registers preoperative MRI/CT to the patient to plan craniotomy and localize tumor margins.

concepts.name: 5-ALA fluorescence-guided resection
concepts.blurb: Oral 5-aminolevulinic acid makes high-grade glioma fluoresce pink under blue light, increasing extent of resection.

concepts.name: Intraoperative MRI
concepts.blurb: Real-time imaging during surgery detects residual tumor and brain shift, prompting further resection before closure.

concepts.name: Intraoperative neuromonitoring for tumors
concepts.blurb: SSEP, MEP, and EMG monitoring protects eloquent pathways during tumor resection near motor cortex or brainstem.
acgme: Intraoperative Neuromonitoring (SSEP MEP EEG) for Tumor Surgery

concepts.name: Laser interstitial thermal therapy
concepts.blurb: MRI-guided stereotactic laser ablation for deep tumors, radiation necrosis, and recurrence inaccessible to open surgery.

concepts.name: Interstitial brachytherapy
concepts.blurb: Implanted radioactive sources deliver focal high-dose radiation to a tumor cavity, used selectively in recurrent disease.
acgme: Neuro-Oncology - Radiation and Chemotherapy Principles (Temozolomide MGMT IDH)

concepts.name: Fractionated external-beam radiation
concepts.blurb: Daily fractions spare normal brain by exploiting repair differences, the basis of conventional tumor radiotherapy.
acgme: Neuro-Oncology - Radiation and Chemotherapy Principles (Temozolomide MGMT IDH)

concepts.name: Stereotactic radiosurgery principles
concepts.blurb: Single or few high-dose sessions with steep dose falloff treat small well-defined targets like metastases and meningiomas.
acgme: Stereotactic Radiosurgery for Brain Tumors (Gamma Knife CyberKnife)

concepts.name: Radiation necrosis
concepts.blurb: Delayed enhancing post-radiation lesion mimicking recurrence; perfusion/PET and bevacizumab or surgery distinguish and treat it.
acgme: Stereotactic Radiosurgery for Brain Tumors (Gamma Knife CyberKnife)

concepts.name: Advanced MRI (perfusion, spectroscopy, PET)
concepts.blurb: Perfusion rCBV, MR spectroscopy, and amino-acid PET differentiate tumor recurrence from treatment effect.
acgme: Advanced MRI - Spectroscopy Perfusion Functional MRI in Neurosurgery

concepts.name: Temozolomide
concepts.blurb: Oral alkylating agent crossing the BBB; benefit greatest with MGMT methylation and central to glioblastoma therapy.
acgme: Neuro-Oncology - Radiation and Chemotherapy Principles (Temozolomide MGMT IDH)

concepts.name: Multidisciplinary tumor board integration
concepts.blurb: Neuro-oncology tumor board coordinates surgery, radiation, medical oncology, and pathology for individualized treatment plans.
acgme: Neuro-Oncology - Radiation and Chemotherapy Principles (Temozolomide MGMT IDH)

concepts.name: Perioperative seizure prophylaxis
concepts.blurb: Prophylactic antiepileptics are not routine without prior seizures; supratentorial tumor craniotomy may warrant short-term coverage.
acgme: Tumor-Related Epilepsy - AED Selection and Perioperative Management

concepts.name: VTE prophylaxis in neuro-oncology
concepts.blurb: Brain tumor patients (especially glioma) have high venous thromboembolism risk requiring balanced mechanical and pharmacologic prophylaxis.
acgme: DVT or PE Prophylaxis in Neurosurgery - Timing Risk Stratification

concepts.name: Tumor craniotomy technique
concepts.blurb: Positioning, flap planning, dural opening, and watertight closure tailored to lesion location for safe tumor access.
acgme: Craniotomy - Opening Exposure and Closing Techniques
